Psychedelics, with particular regard to LSD and shrooms, are a powerful experience. They're not something to take lightly. You CAN do stupid things on them, if you're not around good people. You can end up terrified, in a ball under a sink, thinking time is moving backwards and things will never get back to normal. You can get lost in familiar surroundings, and get into dangerous situations because they make you think so positively about the world that you forget that danger exists.

With that said though, I think they shouldn't be demonized the way that they are. I think it'd be really cool if everyone had the opportunity to do drugs like that in their life, it can give you some great perspective if you enter it with the right mindset.

They should always be used responsibly, not demonized but also not consumed to excess, abused to escape from material problems.
